search: single finite Cartesian grid, fast < slow; no adaptive extensions
objective: maximum strategy cumulative return minus fixed buy_hold cumulative return
execution: signal at close; next quoted tradable bar open; exit signal i cooldown earliest close i+cool; fractional shares, no cost, cash return zero; final open positions marked at final close
warmup: all configured indicators ready: max(fast,slow,breakout+1) observed closes
peak: maximum close from entry signal day inclusive; exit evaluated after updating current close peak
benchmark: first quoted bar open to final close, qfq ratios
tradable_bar_definition: Before any strategy result: exclude tradestatus=0 rows from indicator windows, cooldown and next-bar fills; one suspension row found by input audit. Daily NAV contains quoted tradable bars.
